input.task: Choose a training data source and two different local model jobs for inquiries. New baseline_logged data, when available, comes from seven already completed v1 markets, separate from the development/test markets. Historical fixed/exploration traffic may differ from deployed v1 selection. The baseline forest still handles exact-product recommendations. The trainer fits priors and selects shrinkage8/32/128 using whole-market cross-validation.

recipes.response_hurdle: Learn P(response) from all previous contacts, and P(retained purchase | response) plus value from matured responders. This avoids treating unresolved positives as negatives.
recipes.mature_reward: Learn retained probability and payment reward from settled contacts only, using the same26-day horizon as baseline but trained cohort structure and shrinkage.

grouping.intent_status: Also distinguish new and returning shoppers. More specific but sparser.

output.hypothesis: Using the combined dataset provides the largest sample size, allowing the more specific intent_status grouping to capture differences between new and returning shoppers accurately. The response_hurdle recipe will handle unresolved positives better than mature_reward.
output.rationale: Combined data includes both historical exploration and baseline v1 logged data, reducing selection bias. Intent_status captures the significant differences in netUSD between new and returning shoppers. Response_hurdle avoids treating unresolved positives as negatives, which is crucial given the 26-day horizon.

input.task: Select model + campaign for two different proposed portfolios A and B. We will measure both. Keep baseline as an available fallback. Prediction scores alone are not profit.

modelUse.replace: Replace inquiry probabilities and financial ranking with the fitted model. Earlier trials showed that better prediction could damage merchant value.
modelUse.audit: Preserve v1 probability/ranking. Veto an inquiry only if the fitted model expects negative payment value even with a two-standard-deviation optimistic response estimate and there are no unresolved responders in its cohort. This is a planning heuristic, not a calibrated95% guarantee. Never permanently stop the market.

campaigns.open_discovery: Positive-value needs inquiries can reach consenting shoppers without recent browsing. Recommendations still require current interest.
campaigns.intent_assistance: Only recent interest; inquiry after ambiguous browsing, exact product after explicit search.
campaigns.reactivation: Prior buyers inactive for14days; same consent and funds guards.

objectives.joint: Rank payment plus retailer expected value.
objectives.paypal: Rank expected payment contribution, still require positive retailer expected value.

input.weeklyProbe: If every candidate is rejected, allow at most one needs inquiry every7days when v1 still expects positive payment value (audit mode), or the one-SD optimistic new estimate is positive (replace mode). Same budgets and consent. A bounded disagreement probe, not guaranteed profit.

output.rationale: Testing the best performing model (response_hurdle) in both audit and replace modes with open_discovery and joint objective to maximize retailer contribution and partner cash while improving PayPal net. Weekly probe is enabled to prevent permanent stopping.

input.task: Choose execution for each proposed campaign. The prior full plan lost1.48USD versus removing its complete-basket component on the earlier14markets, but effects were uneven. This is now development evidence, not proof on the upcoming test.

fulfillment.funded_baskets: Locked v1 complete funded-basket planning, approved substitutions, incoming stock and shared cash, then historical cover.
fulfillment.fixed: Strong fixed joint in-stock allocation plus recent14 seven-day stock cover. The baseline-v1 removal trial used this executor.

output.rationale: The fixed fulfillment policy previously outperformed funded_baskets by removing complete-basket coordination, increasing platform contribution. We will use fixed for both campaigns to maximize platform and retailer USD.
output.tradeoff: Using fixed for both campaigns risks missing potential benefits of funded_baskets if the effects vary across different test markets, but it aligns with the strongest historical evidence.
